work.title: Don Giovanni
work.movement: Act I, No. 7, Là ci darem la mano

version.note: An isolated duet on an acoustic disc, not a complete opera performance. The sources do not identify the performing edition or an acoustic orchestral arrangement; cut status is not inferred from duration alone.

performers.note: The institutional ensemble name is not supplied; “Victor Orchestra” is not silently inferred from the label.

date.note: Both primary catalogue records identify the recording date.

place.note: City only; no studio address is established.

catalogue.note: 10-inch, single-faced shellac disc, nominally 78 rpm; DAHR object catalogue dates the issue [1920].

matrixTakeSides.note: DAHR identifies take 2 as the master; takes 1 and 3 are listed as destroyed.

credits.value: Library of Congress National Jukebox, access-file provider; UCSB Davidson Library, source collection
credits.note: The specific transfer operator and facility are unknown. IA presents an access mirror of the National Jukebox file; its generic Packard Campus attribution does not establish the facility for this UCSB-sourced recording. Its claim of no added processing is an uploader statement, not a separate audio comparison.

date.note: The 2026 Internet Archive upload is not treated as the date of the Library of Congress transfer.

processing.note: The selected MP3 is described as a mirror of the National Jukebox access file. Transfer stylus, equalisation and restoration parameters are not established.

digital.format: Internet Archive MP3 mirror of a Library of Congress National Jukebox acoustic-disc transfer

composition.value: Original Mozart music and Da Ponte libretto are out of copyright under the ordinary life-plus-70 rule
composition.note: The historical score and text are distinguished from the recording and from any later translation.

recording.value: Rule 2 — United States recording published in 1920, before the programme cutoff
recording.note: DAHR’s disc record supplies Victor [1920], separately from the 18 February recording date. Under 17 USC 1401, pre-1923 sound recordings entered the US public domain in 2022. The Archive Public Domain Mark is not itself treated as a licence.

rights.creditLine: Mabel Garrison and Reinald Werrenrath, orchestra conducted by Josef Pasternack. Victor 87569, matrix B-23741 take 2; Camden, 18 February 1920; issue [1920]. Source disc: UCSB Davidson Library. National Jukebox transfer, Library of Congress, mirrored by Internet Archive. US pre-1923 publication basis.
